correctness.rationale: With A_ij=c_i>0, y_i=c_i and uniform independent row I_t/coordinate J_t, the residual p_t=1−1^T x_t and centered nullspace z_t=x_t−(1−p_t)1/m obey p_{t+1}=(1−eta_t lambda_{I_t})p_t and z_{t+1}=z_t+eta_t lambda_{I_t}p_t(e_{J_t}−1/m). Independence and E(e_J−1/m)=0 eliminate cross terms; E p_t²=Q_t=prod(1−2a eta_s+b eta_s²), E||z_k||²=(1−1/m)b sum eta_t² Q_t. Orthogonality gives exact solution-error and residual formulas. The bound eta_t lambda_i<1 and sum eta_t infinite ensure p_t→0 pathwise; nonnegative coordinate increments with total mass ≤1 give a.s. bounded convergence, hence mean-square convergence. The variance series has positive t=0 term, so a nonzero limit for every admissible schedule. Independent exact rational branch enumeration k=0,...,6 and matrix 2×2 rational constant-step formula match. Scope excludes arbitrary rank-deficient operators and coordinate-dependent samplings.
